reference_use: Public box covers visually inspected in the in-app browser; reference screenshots used for fresh original fan illustrations, not packaged scans.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. New transparent-background Jumping Flash! (the FIRST game) selection-screen character vignette. Use the original PAL box cover shown as a character and mood reference only, not an edit target; make new original fan illustration. Foreground dominant Robbit in the original first-game proportions: a large silver-white egg-shaped mechanical rabbit chassis with two huge orange-red oval eye pods, black oval slit pupils, yellow R shield on forehead, two long thin white pointed ears with yellow tips, purple spherical leg joints, slender extendable white mechanical legs and long wedge-shaped white rocket shoes with purple undersides. The robot has the rounded vehicle-like shape shown in the reference, not a humanoid rabbit with fur or clothing. Small green '1' on a lower front panel to distinguish it from the sequel, no other writing. Dynamic upward bounding pose with one foot forward, joyous heroic energy. To the upper right, much smaller, recognizable Baron Aloha sits in his little gray flying saucer with glass bell cockpit, top helicopter rotor and spindly landing legs ending in green balls. Aloha is an eccentric small grey moustached man in colorful red patterned aloha clothing; follow the cover's silhouette. Beneath the hero a compact bright green low-poly grass platform, several rounded floating spherical mini-worlds with simple orange/yellow geometric platforms, one small red/white Jet Pod capsule and a yellow spring-pad-like disc; no sprawling town or medieval castle. Distinct sunny first-adventure green/gold/white palette, contrasting the sequel's cosmic purple and Mon Dieu's gold character. Premium late-1990s Japanese PlayStation airbrushed 3D promotional illustration, clean toy forms and soft painted highlights, bold readable silhouettes, vibrant friendly daylight. Robbit occupies at least 65 percent of nearly square composition. Entire ears, feet, saucer and base inside canvas with 8 percent transparent padding. Actual transparent alpha outside the complete compact group, readable at 330px wide. No sky/background rectangle, no game title, no PlayStation logo, no watermark, no box/jewel-case borders. Do not include MuuMuus or Captain Kabuki from the sequel, and do not make Robbit gold.

Use case: stylized-concept. New transparent-background Jumping Flash! 2 game-selection vignette, inspired by the original PAL cover shown in the reference image (reference only). Accurate iconic silver-white spherical Robbit is the dominant foreground hero: egg-like robot chassis, two very large orange-red oval eye pods with black vertical pupils, long pointed white rabbit ears with yellow end caps and violet hinges, purple spherical leg joints, slender extendable white mechanical legs and broad wedge-shaped white rocket feet. Small clearly legible green numeral '2' on the lower front panel, small yellow R shield on the upper chest; those are the only markings. Three-quarter airborne heroic jump, feet and ears entirely in frame. Surround him with four recognizable MuuMuus from the cover: small pear-shaped white beings with simple black oval eyes, tiny rounded white feet/hands and green leaf sprouts ending in tiny orange fruit. Behind the group at smaller scale is a stylized Captain Kabuki inspired by the reference: tall slender pale capsule-shaped head with sly red smile, slim blue arms extended and a red cape with a cream ruffled collar. This supporting villain must not compete with Robbit's face. A small blue-purple curved Little Muu planet fragment and two playful futuristic platforms form a compact lower base, with no cities/castles. Match a premium 1990s PlayStation promotional airbrushed 3D toy-render aesthetic, clean friendly toy forms, readable bold silhouettes, subtle paint texture, polished soft daylight, icy silver/lavender with vivid orange-red and blue-purple accents. Robbit and the MuuMuus occupy at least two thirds of the group. Single centered almost-square composition with 8 percent transparent padding, cutout edge around the entire character tableau; readable at 330px wide. Actual transparent alpha background. No sky, no stars filling the background, no rectangular backdrop, no game-title lettering, no PlayStation logos, no jewel case, no watermark. Do not invent floating medieval cities. Keep the white robotic hero distinctly different from the gold Robbit in Mon Dieu.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new transparent-background game-selection illustration for Robbit Mon Dieu, inspired by the original Japanese cover shown in the reference image (reference only, not an edit target). Make the GOLD/YELLOW Robbit instantly recognizable and dominant: round gold mechanical rabbit body, two very large red oval eye pods with dark slit pupils, long gold antenna-like rabbit ears with pale tips, cream/silver circular belly panel with small green diamond badge, short mechanical legs ending in broad gold shoes with red soles, green ball-like forearm joints and white rounded hands. Follow the character proportions and color placements visible on the cover. Friendly heroic standing/leaping three-quarter pose. Around his lower half arrange just a few Hanauma residents inspired by the cover: small white smiling mushroom-like resident, blue-haired moustached technician, round green bird with yellow beak; no generic human crowd. A tiny bright grassy platform with one palm tree supports this character group. The gold rabbit occupies about 65 percent of the composition; people and grass form a compact bottom third. Premium late-1990s Japanese PlayStation promotional figurine / airbrushed 3D illustration aesthetic: colorful, clean toy materials, readable bold silhouettes, subtle painted detail, warm daylight, coral-red and emerald accents. Single centered collectible character vignette, fully inside canvas with 8 percent transparent padding, nearly square aspect, bottom base softly curved. It will be displayed at only 330 pixels wide, so prioritize faces and silhouette over tiny scenery. Actual transparent alpha outside the complete group. No surrounding city, no fortress, no buildings, no title lettering, no PlayStation branding, no box/jewel case, no watermark, no background sky. Do not make Robbit white.
